title: Fully-credited / zero-payable checkout dead-ends after entitlement is already granted (subscriptions) or is never granted at all (à-la-carte)
ev: artifacts/api-server/src/routes/payments.ts:271-274 (`if (!Number.isInteger(authoritativePaise) || authoritativePaise <= 0) { res.status(409)... }`); artifacts/storefront/lib/moneyPath.ts:142 and :240 (createRazorpayOrder called unconditionally, no zero-payable branch anywhere in the 260-line file); artifacts/api-server/src/routes/subscriptions.ts:1063-1084,1134-1141 and src/lib/subscriptionOrigination.ts:108-148 (chargePaise===0 correctly settles the subscription order server-side as 'preparing', but the client never learns this); artifacts/api-server/src/routes/checkout.ts (order always created status:'placed', no settled/zero-charge branch found by grep, unlike subscriptionOrigination.ts).
obs: For a subscription whose bridge+ledger credit fully covers the price, the server correctly creates and settles the subscription (status active, order status preparing) with zero client payment required, but PlanCheckout.handlePay's runCheckout unconditionally proceeds to finishPlanPayment, which calls createRazorpayOrder and receives a 409 'order has no payable amount' before razorpay.open() is ever invoked. paidFactsRef.current is therefore never set, so the item-1 unresolved-payment safeguard never engages; the catch block instead re-enables the normal pay CTA via setError()+setBusy(false). Re-tapping Pay repeats createdRef.current -> finishPlanPayment -> the same 409, forever. For the guest à-la-carte path (checkout.ts), there is no equivalent server-side settle-at-creation branch at all, so a fully-subsidized guest order is created 'placed' (unpaid) and never transitions — no entitlement is granted and the same 409 dead-end blocks confirmation.
exp: A payable amount of 0 (fully covered by credit, corporate subsidy, or voucher) should skip the Razorpay leg entirely and route straight to the confirmation screen, exactly as BUILD-GAP-ANALYSIS's Wave 1 item 3 recommends: branch in runCheckout/finishPlanPayment (and the equivalent à-la-carte path) when the server-quoted payable is 0, and activate/confirm without calling createRazorpayOrder.
rem: In lib/moneyPath.ts, have runCheckout/runAlacarteCheckout inspect the create response's payable amount (already returned as creditAppliedPaise / payableTotalPaise-equivalent) and short-circuit straight to a CheckoutResult when it is <=0, bypassing finishPlanPayment/finishAlacartePayment entirely. On the api-server side, give checkout.ts the same settled-at-creation branch subscriptionOrigination.ts already has so a fully-subsidized guest order also lands 'preparing' instead of stranded 'placed'.

title: Wellness Studio's `dark:` Tailwind variant classes are driven by raw OS `prefers-color-scheme`, decoupled from the app's actual theme (data-theme/color-scheme)
ev: No `@custom-variant dark` directive exists anywhere in artifacts/storefront's CSS (grepped app/globals.css, app/layers.css, lib/themes/tanmatra.css, lib/themes/stitch.css, lib/themes/tanmatraBridge.css — zero hits), whereas the sibling packages artifacts/agents/src/index.css:5, artifacts/tanmatra/src/index.css:4, and artifacts/mockup-sandbox/src/index.css:4 all define `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))`. components/theme-provider.tsx:29 uses `attribute="data-theme"` (not a `.dark` class) for the app's actual theme switch. 12 storefront component files use raw `dark:`-prefixed Tailwind classes (components/wellness/{PrecisionMealPlanner,BadgeShowcase,LeaderboardTable,FastingClock,PrecisionPlannerFunnel,DailyQuestsCard,PrecisionPlanResults,PantryVisionScanner,FamilyLeaderboardView,HydrationLogger,WellnessHub}.tsx, components/rd/BloodReportOCR.tsx — ~129 occurrences total).
obs: With Tailwind v4 (confirmed via pnpm-workspace.yaml catalog `tailwindcss: ^4.1.14` and postcss.config.mjs's `@tailwindcss/postcss` plugin, no tailwind.config.js present) and no `@custom-variant dark` override, the `dark:` variant compiles to Tailwind v4's built-in default, `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` — a fact of the Tailwind v4 framework rather than something re-derivable purely from this repo's own text, stated here as documented framework behaviour combined with the repo-confirmed absence of any override. rem: Either restyle these 12 files to use the app's semantic tokens (per CLAUDE.md's own 'components stay theme-blind... never `dark:` forks' contract already documented in components/theme-provider.tsx:18 and components/ui/button.tsx:15), or add `@custom-variant dark (&:is([data-theme=dark] *, [data-theme=dark]));` to the storefront's CSS so `dark:` tracks the app's actual resolved theme.

title: Analytics sanitizer cannot filter PostHog SDK auto-attached properties (e.g. $current_url), so the corporate-invite token would reach PostHog's servers via the pageview URL if analytics is ever enabled

This is a design gap to close before those env vars are ever set, not a live leak.
